title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 14, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.9 (Peaked September 14, 2026 at 14:33 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 367 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

Nothing unusual out there. 💛

Today’s imagery shows broad coronal-hole-like regions and modest active-region structure, with no obvious large outward feature in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
